completeness_property: Every reviewed atomic assertion in scope derives exactly one accepted fact or one explicit review-queue item.

scope.non_claim: The system does not prove that the sources describe every real-world component, flow, threat, or control.

atomic_fact_classes.relation: A directed interaction between two deployed-system entities.
atomic_fact_classes.attribute: A property or qualifier of one deployed-system entity.
atomic_fact_classes.uncertainty: An unknown, unverified, absent, contradictory, or unresolved system state.

entity_types.actor: A human role that intentionally interacts with the system.
entity_types.external-entity: A person, organization, or system outside the modeled system that exchanges data with it.
entity_types.process: A running computation that transforms, routes, or acts on data.
entity_types.datastore: A persistent or durable location where data rests.
entity_types.container: A logical or deployment grouping that owns lower-level elements.
entity_types.interface: An exposed interaction surface whose clients may not be fully known at design time.
entity_types.security-service: An identity or security capability that authorizes, filters, encrypts, or audits behavior.
entity_types.block: A control-enforcement component placed on a path.
entity_types.trust-boundary: A boundary between zones with different trust assumptions; it is not a data-processing node.

relationship_types.directed-flow: One source-to-destination transfer represented by one directed edge.
relationship_types.bidirectional-flow: Two independent directed flows with separate data, protocol, authentication, and evidence.
relationship_types.initiates: Metadata identifying which endpoint starts a directed interaction.
relationship_types.contains: A parent-child relationship; each child has at most one immediate parent at a given abstraction level.
relationship_types.crosses-trust-boundary: A derived property when a flow's endpoints belong to different trust zones.

certainty_states.confirmed: Direct evidence supports the positive assertion.
certainty_states.confirmed-absent: Direct evidence supports the absence of the property or control.
certainty_states.unknown: The source explicitly lacks the answer or required evidence is missing.
certainty_states.unverified: A claim exists but has not been checked against implementation evidence.
certainty_states.not-applicable: A completeness obligation was reviewed and does not apply, with rationale.

evidence_contract.span_offsets: codepoint offsets into the scoped transcript section

derivation_rules.rule: Resolve reviewed aliases to a known entity before classification or embedding.
Classify each atomic fragment as relation, attribute, or uncertainty using a closed enum.
Resolve relation endpoints and predicate only from closed enums; an unresolved endpoint cannot create a node.
Represent a bidirectional exchange as two directed relations.
Derive boundary crossing from endpoint trust zones rather than conversational wording alone.
Code copies IDs, labels, evidence, data, protocol, authentication, and certainty; the model never copies them.
Two serial model calls must agree exactly; disagreement produces an unknown review item.
A fact is accepted only after evidence, enum, reference, direction, and reproducibility checks pass.

completeness_rules.obligation: Inventory every route and interface, including legacy paths.
Map every route to a concrete handler or implementation.
Record and verify every path, query, header, and body input constraint.
Record every enabled method or operation for each interface.
Trace every input from entry to every known destination.
Define retention, deletion, or another exit for every persistent data path.
Classify every data element and propagated identifier.
Record transformations, validation, redaction, and sanitization on each flow.
Trace each security-relevant operation through its complete call chain.
Locate authentication and authorization checks on each protected operation.
Model error, timeout, retry, and partial-failure behavior.
Record direct and transitive downstream dependencies.
Mark every untrusted entry point.
Draw boundaries around resources with distinct trust assumptions.
Mark every flow that crosses a trust boundary, including intra-cloud crossings.
Link each claimed boundary protection to verified implementation evidence.
Record every ingress and egress path for each datastore.
Attach a reviewed data classification to every datastore.
Record encryption, versioning, backup, retention, and recovery posture.
Link every reviewed DFD flow to implementation evidence or an explicit unknown.
Link every sensitive-data protection claim to an enforcing control.
Prove that each claimed control covers the exact modeled path.
Assess 100% of blocking obligations and at least 95% of all applicable obligations.

referential_rules: Every dataflow source and destination resolves to exactly one component.
Every component has at most one parent at one abstraction level.
Processed and stored assets are modeled separately.
Threats attach to the component or dataflow where the risky behavior occurs.
A planned mitigation is required, never implemented, until evidence verifies it.
